notes: Partition verified: s001–s013 and t001–t019 each fall in exactly one unit, and every head is a member of its own array.

The italicized 'good' (t002) stays `added`: both ṭôḇ morphemes already hold renderings of their own ('is better', 'precious'), so no morpheme licenses it (rule 30). The competing reading — 'good ... is better' as one discontinuous realization of s001 under rule 25 — is named in that unit's note, and the italic corroborates without deciding (rule 7).

Two article treatments, both correct: 'the day of death' has an article on the rectum rendered anarthrously, so its single 'the' is fronted to that article (rule 29), while the second chain writes no article morpheme and its 'the' is supplied on the construct.
